title: INSIGHT+
summary: Integrated Network Solutions in Government Hiring Trends brings federal personnel, job-posting, occupational, geographic, and institutional data into a common analytic environment.
body_html:
INSIGHT+ transforms fragmented federal workforce data into a documented, extensible infrastructure for research, teaching, and evidence-based workforce strategy.

The platform integrates federal personnel and hiring data with occupational classifications, labor-market measures, geographic context, and institutional attributes. Researchers can examine patterns across agencies, occupations, places, time, and career stages rather than relying on isolated snapshots.
